fullPassage: Would you rather receive $1,000 in a year or $1,100 in a year and a month? Most people will opt for the larger sum in thirteen months — where else will you find a monthly interest rate of 10 percent. A wise choice, since the interest will compensate you generously for any risks you face by waiting the extra few weeks. Second question: Would you prefer $1,000 today cash on the table or $1,100 in a month? If you think like most people, you'll take the $1,000 right away. This is amazing. In both cases, if you hold out for just a month longer, you get $100 more. In the first case, it's simple enough. You figure: "I've already waited twelve months; what's one more?" Not in the second case. The introduction of "now" causes us to make inconsistent decisions. Science calls this phenomenon hyperbolic discounting. The closer a reward is, the higher our "emotional interest rate" rises and the more we are willing to give up in exchange for it.

Second question: Would you prefer $1,000 today cash on the table or $1,100 in a month? If you think like most people, ③<u>you'll take the $1,000 right away</u>. This is amazing. In both cases, if you hold out for just a month longer, you get $100 more. In the first case, it's simple enough. You figure: "I've already waited twelve months; what's one more?" Not in the second case. The introduction of "now" causes us to make inconsistent decisions. Science calls this phenomenon hyperbolic discounting. The closer a reward is, the higher our "emotional interest rate" rises and ④<u>the more we are willing to give up</u> in exchange for it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 부사와 형용사를 구분하는 어법 문제이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① Most people will opt for the larger sum — 올바름
❌ ② compensate you generous → compensate you generously: 동사 compensate를 수식하는 부사 generously가 필요. 형용사 generous는 오류 ←정답
✅ ③ you'll take the $1,000 right away — 올바름
✅ ④ the more we are willing to give up — 올바름
det.tip: 동사를 수식할 때는 형용사가 아닌 부사를 사용해야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 본문 주제: 즉각적 보상 선호가 비일관적 결정을 유발하는 쌍곡선 할인 현상
det.analysis:
❌ ① 장기 투자가 단기 투자보다 이자율이 높은 이유 — 본문은 이자율 비교가 아니라 심리적 편향이 핵심
❌ ② 현금 보유가 은행 저축보다 유리한 경제 상황 — 본문과 무관
❌ ③ 이자율 변동이 소비자 행동에 미치는 영향 — 이자율은 비유이지 실제 경제 주제가 아님
✅ ④ 즉각적인 보상에 대한 선호가 합리적 판단을 흐리는 현상 — hyperbolic discounting의 핵심 ←정답
det.tip: 주제는 본문 전체를 포괄하는 핵심 내용이어야 한다.
